selection: Start from the player's fired tags in their display order (strong tags first by net support, then coverage share), the same order library.json tagRules.firing sets.
Skip any tag with shareable false (T11A, T11B kids; T21A, T21B weddings). They can still appear on owner-only screens, never on the share image.
Take the first 3, at most one per chapter when the fired list allows it; if the next tag repeats a chapter already used, try the following one and fall back to it only when nothing else is left.
If fewer than 3 are left, fill from the player's strongest stat ends (strongest first) using the fallback map, skipping any tag already shown or whose pair is shown.
Show each tell in the voice the player picked (fun or heart). The tell is the chip text; the tag name stays the label on the article and owner screens.
